mapper.select: select o.`id`, o.`company_id`, o.`name`, o.`handle_type`, o.`busy_type`, o.`queue_timeout`, o.`busy_timeout_type`, o.`overflow_type`, o.`overflow_value`, o.`lineup_expression`, o.`create_dept`, o.`create_by`, o.`create_time`, o.`update_by`, o.`update_time` from fs_group_overflow rel join fs_group g on g.id = rel.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' join fs_overflow_config o on o.id = rel.overflow_id and o.company_id = g.company_id and o.del_flag = '0' join fs_company c on c.id = g.company_id and c.del_flag = '0' where rel.del_flag = '0' and g.company_id = #{companyId} and rel.group_id = #{groupId} order by rel.level_value, rel.id
